title: Anonymous sources: bodies came from a subterranean tunnel system

tellings.quote: A few different anonymous sources revealed to me that the actual source of these bodies is a large subterranean tunnel system.

plain: The strange three-fingered bodies said to have been found around Nazca, in Peru, actually come from a large underground tunnel system. Michels says this himself, and he says it was told to him by a few different sources he does not name. If true, it would point to where the bodies really came from and what else might lie below.
